strategies.name: Mean Reversion Scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Enter a long position after price sharply moves into a strong support level, anticipating a reversal and bounce.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit the trade by capturing the bounce off the support level, using the bids at the support as protection.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Look for volume to stall and a pause in hitting the bid (hesitation of sellers).
variants.target_note: Capture the bounce off the support level.
variants.transcript_quote: On a sharp down move into support, you will often see a moment where volume stalls, and it's this pause where people stop hitting the bid.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Look for large offers at resistance and anticipate a reversal.
variants.target_note: Capture the reversal off the resistance level.
variants.transcript_quote: The sharper and bigger the move into really big bids or offers, the better it is to scalp a reversal.

strategies.name: Continuation Scalp
strategies.entry_summary: Enter a long position immediately upon a clean break of a psychological resistance level, betting on emotional follow-through.
strategies.exit_summary: Exit the trade by capturing the momentum of the breakout, potentially taking profits 10, 20, or 30 cents higher.

variants.target_note: Capture the momentum of the breakout (10, 20, or 30 cents higher).

strategies.exit_summary: Exit the trade by capturing the difference between the bid and offer (the spread) as market participants cross the spread.
